title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Lavender | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. Four pivoting arms provide space to hang and separate towels, helping you maximize bathroom space.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent floor scratching
- Part of the Soho collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs:
- Collection: Soho
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Freestanding
- Dimensions: 12-Inch L x 9.25-Inch W x 49-Inch H
- Diameter: 1-Inch
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 13.6 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included items: Towel stand
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
